answer.text: Assuring returns on any Investment Approach

explanation.text: The Logic: PMS distributors must abstain from assuring returns in any type of Investment Approach and from misrepresentation. The Trap: Sharing the Disclosure Document, disclosing commissions, and conducting KYC are duties, not prohibitions. Note: Distributors also have disclosure-document, commission-disclosure, and KYC duties under the Code.
